data.detail: Could not get a single tap to land on the home page. The story carousel rotates every few seconds and every act (7 tries at 'Rechazar todo' in the cookie panel) was refused with 'the page changed'. Part of this is probably the walk tool racing the carousel rather than a person's tap failing, but the auto-rotating carousel is the cause. From the hero alone I learned what the group does and where; I never reached 'Involúcrate' to find a way to take part that isn't money.
